summary: Phase 1 Codebase Health Score refactor batch verification. Validated: (1) GET /api/aurem-dev/admin/health-score returns 200 with all 9 categories; code_quality=43 (up from 39), bloated_files=170, complex_files=202 — matches expected metrics. (2) Endpoints touched by refactored helpers all return non-5xx (engagement/my-streak, founder-offer/claim, admin/support/errors, advisor open-prs graceful on missing repo). (3) Frontend UI: Cookie consent banner works end-to-end (Accept persists to localStorage key 'aurem_consent' with correct schema). (4) Admin 2FA enroll flow renders correctly — all critical testids present (admin-2fa-enroll-panel, admin-2fa-qr, admin-2fa-secret, admin-2fa-backup-codes, admin-2fa-confirm-input, admin-2fa-confirm-submit, admin-2fa-enroll-cancel); QR + secret + 8 backup codes visibly render on screenshot. (5) TabBar on /dashboard renders tabs (ds2-tab-chat/preview/graph) and active project persists via localStorage key 'aurem_active_project'. (6) Vercel card on /settings?tab=integrations renders with vercel-status-disconnected (VERCEL_API_TOKEN not set in preview) — VercelTryItRow is correctly conditionally hidden when not connected (matches original behavior, {status?.connected && <VercelTryItRow/>} guard). All 5 backend pytest smoke tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Vercel try-it row visibility depends on Vercel connection state — could not exercise Run flow because preview env has VERCEL_API_TOKEN unset. Refactor extraction (VercelTryItRow.jsx) verified structurally sound (import + conditional render preserved), but full end-to-end 'Run tool -> result' path is not exercised in preview. Consider adding a Vercel-connected test environment or a mocked connected state for full E2E coverage of the extracted VercelTryItRow.

Some pre-existing test failures noted by main agent (2 AWS/GCP regex, 3 ora_learning log-string, 2 CI-ingest-token) remain out of scope for this refactor batch — track as separate CI/test-triage backlog items.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested surfaces (2FA enroll, cookie banner, TabBar, Vercel card render). Vercel Run flow not exercised (env dependency).
